sentences.text: 1  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MALASRI NANDI  ORDER Date : 13.08.2024 Heard Mr. N. Haque, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. D.P.
Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam and Mr. Z. Hussain, learned counsel for the respondent No. 2.
2.

By this petition filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioner, namely, Jahanara Begum, has prayed for granting pre-arrest bail, apprehending arrest in connection with Chhaygaon P.S. Case No. 134/2024 under Section 120(B)/342/376(3)/506 IPC r/w Section 6/17 of POCSO Act, 2012.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is no way involved in the alleged incident as stated in the FIR.
It is also submitted that the instant FIR has been lodged after five months of the alleged incident.
However, the learned counsel for the petitioner further submitted that the informant demanded Rs.6,00,000/- from the petitioner to compromise the matter.
It is further submitted that the provision of POCSO Act or Section 376 IPC is not attracted against the petitioner.
Considering the background of the case, the previlege of pre-arrest may be extended to the petitioner.

4. Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State has produced the case diary along with the relevant documents and submits that the petitioner may appear before the investigating officer for recording her statement.
5. Mr. Hussain, learned counsel for the respondent No. 2 submits Page No.# 3/3 that he has objection in granting bail to the petitioner.
6. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties.
I have also perused the case diary.
7. It appears that Section 4 of POCSO Act or Section 376 IPC is not attracted against the petitioner.
Considering the facts as well as the documents available in the case diary, this Court finds that till completion of DNA test, the petitioner is granted interim protection.

8. Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the petitioner, named above, in connection with Chhaygaon P.S. Case No. 134/2024 under Section 120(B)/342/376(3)/506 IPC r/w Section 6/17 of POCSO Act, 2012, he shall be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

9. The direction for pre-arrest bail is subject to the conditions that the petitioner:
(a) shall appear before the Investigating Police Officer within ten days from today and shall co-operate with the investigation;
Jahanara Begum vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89508030/
2 (b) shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
10. Send back the case diary.
